Method of Attack: Rewrites flash storage to 'brick' Linux-based IoT and networking devices, rendering them inoperable
Exploits unsecured TR069 (TR064) interfaces with hard-coded logins to reconfigure devices for MITM attacks or DNS hijacking
Uses open port 7547 on routers and modems to execute code remotely
Discoverer: BrickerBot author (also known as The Doctor)
Impacted Systems: Modems and routers of Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)
Modems and routers of Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unsecured TR069 (TR064) management protocol interfaces exposed on port 7547
Use of hard-coded login credentials in devices
Indicators of Compromise: Devices with red LED always on indicating loss of connectivity
Modems stuck and unable to connect to the Internet
Presence of hard-coded logins beyond default admin/admin credentials
